title: Malaria outbreak in Balaghat, death toll rise to 28+ #balaghat #adiwasi #malaria #madhyapradesh
ground_truth: Local reports confirm 25 deaths, with the crisis severely exacerbated by missing nutrition rations and reliance on contaminated stream water.
official_record: Official Balaghat government statements acknowledge 8 deaths.
context_gap: The video exaggerates the death toll to '28+' (compared to the official 8 and local 25). It also completely omits critical structural failures reported on the ground, specifically the missing nutrition rations and the consumption of contaminated stream water, which are key drivers of the high mortality and vulnerability in the region.
